scope: V3 CPU scene geometry and scheduling preflight; does not certify final graphic quality
coordinateSystem: Right-handed Three.js: geographic (cos(lat)cos(lon), sin(lat), -cos(lat)sin(lon)); Earth radius=1

firstHalfSecondMotion.scope: Authored camera pose movement, not a black/frozen/visible-pixel test

camera.thresholdNote: Angular/position steps are observations, not automatic judgments of cinematic smoothness

routes.endpointInterpretation: Horizontal geographic error; 11km radial endpoint altitude is intentional, not airport location error
Horizontal geographic error; 11km radial endpoint altitude is intentional, not airport location error

globalVisibleVertexMinimumBracketKm.scope: Uncertain poses use all actual vertices. Other poses use conservative box bounds. An unresolved bracket must not be described as an exact global minimum

uncertainVisibleFullVertexValidation.scope: Actual transformed vertex distances at uncertain visible nominal/half poses; negative box bounds remain candidates, not detected collisions

aircraft.boundNote: Cached static part geometry; positive oriented-box lower bound covers the entire model. Negative box bound is inconclusive, not a detected model collision
aircraft.transitionNote: Route endpoints share the same Narita coordinates. Route-switch heading is reported separately and only included in visible-heading metrics when both samples exceed the opacity threshold

authoredEvents.scope: Declared event schedule; actual meaningful visual-event visibility must be inspected in encoded frames

cinematicInsertContract.scope: Scheduling and caller handoff only; no video decoding, frame compositing, or transition quality claim

limitations: No browser/GPU, asset load, black/duplicate frame, text/viewport clipping, color, audio or playback validation.
Routes are checked at their centerlines; visual tube thickness and glow envelopes require renderer/frame checks.
Full vertex tests do not prove triangle-interior clearance between vertices or motion between the sampled times; dense conservative box bounds cover complete geometry only at poses where positive.
Aircraft scale is illustrative, not a statement of physical fuselage length or real elapsed flight time.
Pixel visibility and empirical viewer attention/retention are not measured.
